description:
The Himalayas. A natural wall between worlds. In this journey, we trace the arc of the world’s highest mountain range, exploring its sacred valleys and iconic peaks. 
The cultural mosaic of Kathmandu, windswept deserts of Ladakh, forests of Bhutan, glaciers of Nepal, and much more.
